# dist/

Auto-generated. Each `.zip` here is a straight zip of the matching `skills/<name>/` folder, rebuilt by the [`.githooks/pre-commit`](../.githooks/pre-commit) hook whenever a commit touches `skills/*/SKILL.md`.

That hook only runs if you've set it up once: `make install`.

Don't edit these files directly — edit the source under [`skills/`](../skills/) instead. Download links and descriptions live in the [root README](../README.md#for-claude-desktop-users).
